verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly ships an official (and hosted) MCP server, documented explicitly as a way for AI agents/assistants to interact with the product, which enables natural-language operation of flags, targeting, and rollouts. However, there is no independent/hands-on evidence of NL command usage in practice, and the CLI (ldcli) is a scripted interface rather than NL. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of natural-language command success, examples of specific NL commands/queries supported, and evidence of broader in-product NL/chat interface beyond MCP integration.
